title: Minecraft: Jan's Hell Mod(e)
description: A few small tweaks i made to Minecraft to make it 1.523e6x harder
body:
A few changes I made to Minecraft that make it much more annoying and harder to play.
Changes include, but are not limited to:
- Worsening of several crafting recipes
- Climate change
- Punishment for standing on blocks that contain the letter "E" in their **registry** name (not including prefix (this feature is incompatible with other mods))
- A Pride dimension (required to obtain Eyes of Ender)

This mod holds back no punches, and is only meant for the most hardcore of gamers.
